entities.name: The android calling itself 'the last thing'

claims.subject: tezzeret

evidence.quote: He was ejected from the Blind Eternities by methods still unknown.
However, Tezzeret's travels have brought him to an unexpected destination.

claims.summary: After the Phyrexian invasion, Tezzeret was ejected from the Blind Eternities into the Edge by unknown means.

claims.subject: tezzeret

evidence.quote: He bides his time fencing stolen goods, filing the numbers off the transponders of stolen spacecraft, and monopolizing the ice water trade—all while aiming to lay the foundations of a criminal consortium.
Though Tezzeret's original goal was to find a way home, now he's not so sure.

claims.summary: In the Edge, Tezzeret builds a criminal consortium and is no longer sure he wants to go home.

claims.subject: sami

evidence.quote: The plucky young captain of the Seriema, Sami is a wildcat, an unaffiliated freelancer with their own ship who takes jobs from anyone paying—whether with mallowmass or something archaic like currency.

claims.summary: Sami is the freelancer captain of the Seriema.

claims.subject: tannuk

evidence.quote: Together with their first mate, Tannuk, Sami is looking for the score that will restore their fortunes.
Today, Tannuk is the last remaining member of Sami's crew after the rest split for a more lucrative ship.

claims.summary: Tannuk, a dishonorably discharged Kav navy pilot, is Sami's first mate and last remaining crew member.

claims.subject: haliya

evidence.quote: Having recently arrived in Sothera, Haliya is a bright and eager squire in the Sunstar Free Company.
Haliya has pledged her bladiator to the service of Syr Vondam, her mentor and idol who has trained her since she was a young woman.

claims.summary: Haliya is a Sunstar Free Company squire who pledged her service to her mentor Syr Vondam.

claims.subject: vondam

evidence.quote: Syr Vondam is a high-ranking knight of the Sunstar Free Company who commands a knightly host assigned to defend the Dawnsire.

claims.summary: Syr Vondam commands the knightly host defending the Dawnsire.

claims.subject: monoists

evidence.quote: She traveled there aboard the Dawnsire, a horizon javelin and kilometers-long vessel that will reignite the Sotheran supervoid—something the system's Monoists will do anything to prevent.

claims.summary: The Dawnsire is meant to reignite the Sotheran supervoid; the Monoists will do anything to prevent it.

claims.subject: alpharael

evidence.quote: Alpharael is a young acolyte who has lived his entire life inside the Monoist monastery in the shadow of the Sotheran supervoid.
Now tasked with eliminating the Sunstar Free Company's hold on Sothera—a mission he is unlikely to survive—he finds his faith wavering.

claims.summary: Alpharael, a Monoist acolyte, is tasked with eliminating the Sunstar Free Company's hold on Sothera.

claims.subject: mmmenon

evidence.quote: After being expelled from the Combine, Mm'menon lent their services to Tezzeret to stay in-system, hoping to solve the mystery of Uthros and capitalize on it.

claims.summary: The expelled Illvoi researcher Mm'menon serves Tezzeret.

claims.subject: tezzeret

evidence.quote: "Yes. I chose the most desperate, disposable pawns in my employ. So that they could not succeed except by the favor of the thing hidden on Sigma.
And I made it my genuine intention to bring that thing, once it was in my possession, wherever it wanted to go."

claims.summary: Tezzeret says he deliberately sent Sami's crew after the Endstone on Sigma and intended to take it wherever it wanted to go.
claims.limitation: Motive is stated by Tezzeret in dialogue; his account is not independently confirmed by narration.

claims.subject: vondam

evidence.quote: The Sundog is killing everything in Taro-duend with its lasers.
"Syr," she says, unable to break the habit of respect, "it wasn't the Endstone. You just shouldn't have murdered all those Kav.
All the Kav in Taro-duend rose up to protect Sami and Tannuk and Alpharael from the Free Company. All the Kav in Taro-duend died for it.
"Isn't that what Vondam must've told himself before he gave the order to kill everyone in Taro-duend?

claims.summary: The Free Company destroys the Kav settlement at Taro-duend; Haliya holds Vondam responsible for the massacre.
claims.limitation: Narration shows the Sundog attacking Taro-duend; Vondam's personal order is attributed in character dialogue, and the story leaves open whether the Endstone influenced him.

claims.subject: haliya

evidence.quote: I've been cast out of the Free Company, but I am still a Summist. I place myself on errantry.

claims.summary: After Taro-duend, Haliya is cast out of the Sunstar Free Company and goes on errantry, still a Summist.

claims.subject: last_thing_android

evidence.quote: The figure translates beside him. The Endstone falls into its hand.
But stars and nebulae close before it, and it is gone. Just gone. The Endstone with it.
"I am the last thing," the beautiful android says.

claims.summary: An android calling itself 'the last thing' appears aboard the Seriema, takes the Endstone and vanishes with it.

claims.subject: tezzeret

evidence.quote: Tezzeret's mission is complete. The Endstone has been delivered. He has his glimpse of higher power.

claims.summary: Tezzeret considers his mission complete once the Endstone is delivered to the android.

claims.subject: last_thing_android

evidence.quote: The other fingers on its hand fasten around Haliya's throat and crush.
Haliya's blade goes through two of its fingers.

claims.summary: Haliya attacks the android, severing two fingers; it crushes her throat (treatable).

claims.subject: pinnacle

evidence.quote: Pinnacle is a collective administrative entity.
In fact, intrasystem conflict and commerce are founding concerns of Pinnacle; namely, the cessation of the former and the encouragement of the latter.

claims.summary: Pinnacle is the collective interstellar administration whose founding concerns are ending conflict and encouraging commerce.
claims.limitation: related_to is a weak placeholder; the guide does not give Pinnacle's exact jurisdiction over Sothera in these sentences.

claims.subject: haliya

evidence.quote: "Syr," Haliya manages, "it wasn't your choice. It was mine. I took the Endstone away. It's not on you."
"Yes. That was your error. And it was my responsibility to kill you for it. Which I failed to do, because I let love outshine duty.

claims.summary: Haliya took the Endstone away from Vondam and the Free Company; Vondam says he failed in his duty to kill her for it.
claims.limitation: Both statements are dialogue in Episode 11; the act itself occurs in earlier episodes not cited here.

remaining: Episodes 2-7 (Uthros, the Seriema's flight, Vondam's head wound) are only lightly used
Side stories (Grasp in the Dark, The Doors of Uthros, Kadrik and the Pod, Compact Me to Zero, The Wefthunter) are not cited
The android's identity and the supervoid's nature are left as open questions; not graded
